goal: Add native settings foundation with DataStore-backed theme/avatar/memo placeholders and native about/diagnostics metadata.
non_goals: Do not implement full LLM profile CRUD.
Do not implement real provider connection tests.
Do not implement app update download/install behavior.
Do not implement full memo editor gestures.
Do not implement secure key storage.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
acceptance_criteria: Settings route is reachable from the native app shell.
About/diagnostics route displays native app metadata.
DataStore-backed app preferences include theme, global avatar visibility, and memo placeholders.
Local preferences persist across repository/app recreation.
PWA install hints are not carried into native about UI.
No API key values are stored in DataStore.
verification_expectations: Write failing tests before production settings implementation.
Run :core:data:connectedDebugAndroidTest if an ADB device is available.
Run app module tests for navigation/reachability if changed.
Run native Gradle assembleDebug, test, and lint.
If ADB device is available, install and launch preview and capture settings/about reachability evidence.
notes: This is a settings foundation task. Full settings feature parity arrives in later tasks.
Use DataStore only for lightweight preferences; do not store raw API keys.
